question: How many oblations of cooked offerings and fire materials may be performed in the rite?
premises: Cooked offerings and fire materials are to be offered.
One prescribed count is one hundred oblations.
An alternative count of fifty oblations is permitted.
inference: The rite allows either one hundred or fifty oblations of the prescribed materials.
plain_english: The cooked offerings and fire-oblation materials may be offered one hundred times, or alternatively fifty times.
